title: ProductRequest
description: POST /api/library/product (contract §2.11): {url, llm?} for the server to read the page, or {html, url?, llm?} for a page the user's browser copied (then nothing is fetched). llm: false skips the language model.

url.description: The product page's link (http or https). v1 refuses one over 4096 characters (400).

html.description: The page's source, not blank; over 10 MB it is cut, with a warning.
